messages:
Maria G.: heads-up: EU-west embeddings queue spiked ~5x at 12:03UTC, rerank lane started consuming extra GPU slots and embeddings started getting rate-limited. seeing large requeue churn and ~2.1k pending embed requests in redis-backlog.
Trevor: can you paste the backlog metric? redis list length or our queueing metric?
Maria G.: redis_backlog_len=2143, embed_avg_wait=4.8s, rerank_avg_wait=1.2s. host-level GPU util on embed nodes ~85%, rerank nodes ~95% and its autoscaler didn't spin up more because pod limits hit. logs show a lot of: 
```
WARN admission: request rejected: lane=embeddings reason=exhausted_capacity route=/v1/embeddings
```
Anil: looks like rerank concurrency bumped because of a burst from a single customer. Their weighted-fairshare allowed them to grab spare rerank slots, but we don't have cross-lane caps so rerank bled into embedding pool. We should immediately re-add lane isolation soft-cap.
Olivia: temporary mitigation idea: adjust admission controller to prefer embeddings over rerank for PLG tier and collapse rerank to burst-only mode (burst until x then drain). I can push a config change to canary in eu-west.
sre-oncall: also seeing NAT egress SNAT table nearing limits for the eu-west subnet — connections are being intermittently reset which makes clients retry and amplifies the burst. If we keep scaling without fixing SNAT we'll just loop. Opening infra ticket to add ephemeral SNAT entries.
Trevor: agree on two-prong: 1) quick admission controller tweak to cap rerank concurrency per-host to 40% of node capacity, 2) infra to unblock SNAT. For (1) propose this hotpatch: 
```
# admission controller hotpatch
lane_caps:
  embeddings: 0.55  # keep >50% capacity
  rerank: 0.25      # strongly limit until autoscaler recovers
  general: 0.20
```
apply to eu-west replica group only.

Maria G.: deployed the admission hotpatch to eu-west-canary, watching metrics... backlog dropped from 2143 -> 762 in 3m, embed_avg_wait down to 1.6s. rerank tail latency increased but within SLO for canary customers.
Anil: good. After we stabilise we should implement a more robust cross-lane admission policy: token-bucket per-lane at node-level + prioritized queue where embeddings get preemptive slots if avg_wait > threshold. That avoids global bled-through like this. I'll draft a design doc.
Olivia: note on cost: if we add strict isolation we'll need more reserved capacity for peak rerank, which increases committed spend. Maybe we can rely on elastic burst with a stricter fallback to cheaper quantized models for rerank when saturated. Worth modelling tradeoffs.
Trevor: flagged cost analysis with finance; but immediate next steps: 1) keep hotpatch in eu-west for 2h, 2) infra to fix SNAT (sre-oncall), 3) Anil to start cross-lane admission doc, 4) Olivia to prototype rerank fallback to quantized V2 to reduce GPU time.
sre-oncall: infra ticket created: INF-5124 SNAT exhaustion in eu-west, requested quota bump and temporary NAT gateway horizontally scaled. ETA 45m.
engbot: alert: eu-west admission-hotpatch deployed to canary at 12:18UTC by Maria G. (runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/emb-lane-hotpatch) :thumbsup:
Maria G.: thanks all — will update when we decide rollout to prod. If anyone sees requeue >1500 ping me.
Olivia: small note: add a quick Prom alert for cross-lane queue imbalance (ratio rerank_backlog / embed_backlog > 2) so we catch this earlier. I'll add it after the doc.
Trevor: perfect. closing for now, will post postmortem if this recurs.
